title: armeria alliacea subsp. bupleuroides
intro: Armeria alliacea subsp. bupleuroides, commonly known as Alliaria bupleuroides or Bupleurum alliaceum, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fever, and pain, as well as its potential to improve digestion and liver function. The bioactive constituents of Armeria alliacea subsp. bupleuroides include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
